title.en: An Act Converting the Sitio of Cabili, Municipality of Panabo, Province of Davao, into a Barrio of Said Municipality to be Known as the Barrio of Quezon
title.orig: An Act Converting the Sitio of Cabili, Municipality of Panabo, Province of Davao, into a Barrio of Said Municipality to be Known as the Barrio of Quezon
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Sitio Cabili tại Thị trấn Panabo, Tỉnh Davao thành Barrio của thị trấn nói trên với tên gọi Barrio Quezon
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะซิติโอ Cabili ในเทศบาล Panabo จังหวัด Davao เป็น บาริโอของเทศบาลดังกล่าวในชื่อบาริโอ Quezon
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sitio Cabili di Kotamadya Panabo, Provinsi Davao menjadi Barrio dari kotamadya tersebut dengan nama Barrio Quezon
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sitio Cabili di Perbandaran Panabo, Wilayah Davao kepada Barrio daripada perbandaran tersebut dengan nama Barrio Quezon

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1711_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Cabili, Municipality of Panabo, Province of Davao, is converted into a barrio of said municipality to be known as the barrio of Quezon.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
